title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - IDOR in backend data export in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - The…
description: An Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability exists in the backend data export functionality of the Visforms Joomla extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.4 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.1. This flaw allows backend users to export data from forms they are not authorized to access due to improper permission verification during export operations.
